data.one_liner: Drop-in Text and TextEditingController replacements for inline Markdown-like text formatting
data.what_it_does: Provides Textf and TextfEditingController widgets that support inline Markdown formatting like bold, italic, code, links, highlights, and super/subscripts directly in Flutter text layouts and text fields.
use_when: You need inline markdown formatting in chat messages, comments, or UI labels
You want live formatting updates as users type in a TextField
avoid_when: You need a full Markdown renderer supporting multi-line structures like lists, tables, or blockquotes
You need deep nesting beyond 2 levels
strengths: Drop-in replacements for standard Text and TextEditingController widgets
Supports live formatting in text fields as the user types
weaknesses: Inline-first with limited block support (only ATX headings and thematic breaks)
Maximum of 2 nesting levels of formatting
Selections cannot span across links due to WidgetSpan usage
